question: What condition must hold for the act of applying meditation to remain in force after worship of the circle?
premises: Worship of the circle is performed first in sequence.
Meditation is applied for a limited duration of time.
The duration of application is bounded by the temporal limit stated.
inference: Application of meditation is temporally contingent on the prior worship of the circle.
uncertainties: Extent of the temporal limit remains unspecified.
plain_english: Having worshipped this circle, one applies meditation for as long as that practice lasts.
